briefTitle: A Phase 2 Study of Zanidatamab in Patients With HER2-expressing Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic solid tumors... who have progressed following at least 1 prior systemic treatment for metastatic or advanced disease and have no available treatment options that have confirmed benefit. Prior treatment with HER2-targeted therapy is not permitted (Cohort 1 only). For participants with breast cancer (Cohort 2) or GEA (Cohort 3), prior HER2-targeted therapy is permitted and prior therapy with trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) is required.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy requirements and exclusions differ by cohort, making it impossible to express as a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: HER2 overexpression (IHC 3+) must be determined by a sponsor designated central laboratory.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There is no typed kind for HER2 overexpression.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: All participants must have adequate tumor sample for submission to allow central HER2 testing.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Tissue submission requirement is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of at least 1 measurable lesion as assessed by Independent Central Review (ICR) based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors Version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a life expectancy of at least 3 months, in the opinion of the investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Colorectal Cancer (CRC) participants with known KRAS/NRAS and BRAF mutations.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This exclusion applies specifically to Colorectal Cancer and includes NRAS which lacks a typed kind.
